Repo: https://github.com/clawdbot/clawdbot. Source `src/`; tests colocated `*.test.ts`; docs `docs/`; plugins `extensions/*`; built output `dist/`. Runtime Node **22+**. Install: `pnpm install`; also `bun install`. Prefer Bun: `bun <file.ts>` / `bunx <tool>`. Dev: `pnpm clawdbot ...` or `pnpm dev`. Build: `pnpm build`; lint: `pnpm lint`; format: `pnpm format`; tests: `pnpm test`; coverage: `pnpm test:coverage`.

Keep Node + Bun paths working. Prefer strict typing; avoid `any`. Never commit or publish real phone numbers, videos, or live configuration values. Never edit `node_modules`. Never update the Carbon dependency. Patching dependencies requires explicit approval; do not do this by default. Any dependency with `pnpm.patchedDependencies` must use an exact version (no `^`/`~`).

**Multi-agent safety:** do **not** create/apply/drop `git stash` entries unless explicitly requested (this includes `git pull --rebase --autostash`). **Multi-agent safety:** do **not** create/remove/modify `git worktree` checkouts (or edit `.worktrees/*`) unless explicitly requested. **Multi-agent safety:** do **not** switch branches / check out a different branch unless explicitly requested. When user says “commit”, scope to your changes only.

Before PR review: `git pull`; if local changes or unpushed commits, stop and alert user. Review with `gh pr view`/`gh pr diff`; do not change branches. Full gate: `pnpm lint && pnpm build && pnpm test`. Create commits with `sc
